title: A Model Organism for Studying Unverbalized Evaluation Awareness
author: Daniel Donnelly, Evan Chapple, Haritz Puerto, Sahar Abdelnabi
description: arXiv:2611.09945v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models can recognize when they are being evaluated and change their behavior accordingly, undermining the reliability of safety benchmarks. Evaluation awareness (EA) is usually measured by having an LLM judge scan reasoning traces for explicit statements…
